categorias_que.rastreador: An open list knows it as tracking: it follows you from one site to the next.
categorias_que.publicidad: It is on the advertising lists: it shows you ads, or measures them.
categorias_que.telemetria: Usage data a program sends back to its maker.
categorias_que.esperado: What a machine needs to work: updates, time, messaging, video calls.
categorias_que.desconocido: No open tracking list knows it. It does not mean it is suspicious.
categorias_que.red_local: Devices in your home finding each other. It never leaves.
categorias_que.entrega: A network that carries other companies’ content. Not the destination: the road.
categorias_que.de_empresa: Who the name belongs to is known. A label, never a verdict.

cli.uso:
Usage:
  guardiana observe [--listen IP:PORT] [--upstream IP[:PORT]]... [--db PATH] [--canary] [--open] [--no-panel] [--panel-listen IP:PORT]
  guardiana ledger [--check | --wipe | --self | --last N] [--db PATH]
  guardiana export [--csv | --json] [--out FILE] [--device ID] [--category C] [--signal S] [--verdict V] [--limit N] [--db PATH]
  guardiana dns [--status | --apply --yes | --restore] [--db PATH]
  guardiana licencia [clave KEY | archivo PATH | comprobar]
  guardiana verify [--json]
  guardiana reglas [deshacer ID | deshacer-hoy]

  guardiana hogar [status | on | off]
  guardiana service [install | uninstall | start | stop | status]
  guardiana panel                (opens the panel in the browser)
  guardiana menu [--choice N]     (interactive test menu)
  guardiana boveda …                (the encrypted vault: guardiana boveda alone lists its commands)
  guardiana version

cli.verify.firma.dev: Signature: this program carries the DEVELOPMENT key, not the release key. There is no signature to check; it is not a released version.
cli.verify.firma.sin_archivo: Signature: there is no .minisig file next to the program. The signature cannot be checked.
cli.verify.firma.ok: Signature: correct. The program is signed with the Guardiana key it carries inside.
cli.verify.firma.mal: Signature: does NOT match. The program or its signature have changed. Do not use it until this is cleared up.
cli.verify.registro.sin_archivo: Public record: there is no ledger.jsonl on this machine (checked by hand against the one published on the website).
cli.verify.registro.no_esta: Public record: this fingerprint is NOT in ledger.jsonl. If this is a released version, something is off.
cli.verify.registro.ok: Public record: matches version {v} published on {fecha} (Rekor {rekor}).
cli.verify.dns.guardiana_primario: Guardiana changed the DNS: this machine's queries go through it.
cli.verify.dns.guardiana_no_primario: Guardiana changed the DNS but RIGHT NOW the queries do not go through it: the system changed it back. The service reapplies it every minute; if it persists, use guardiana dns --apply --yes.
cli.verify.dns.guardiana_desconocido: Guardiana changed the DNS; could not check whether the queries go through it right now.
cli.verify.dns.sin_cambiar: Guardiana has not changed the system DNS.
cli.extracto.otra_clave: This ledger does not belong to this version of Guardiana: it was created by a version signed with a different key, and the two are never mixed. If you are coming from a test version, move the ledger file elsewhere and Guardiana will start a new one. If you were not expecting this, delete nothing and write to hola@guardianagroup.com.
cli.verify.dns.solo_guardiana_sin_copia: System DNS: Guardiana (127.0.0.1) and nothing else. Every query from this machine goes through it.
cli.verify.dns.apunta_sin_copia: This machine points at Guardiana, but Guardiana did not make that change: it has no record of the DNS you had before. On uninstall it will not be able to put it back. Apply it again from the panel so it is recorded.
cli.verify.vigilante: Guard mode on for: {aparatos}. On those devices everything outside the declared scope is cut, not only what the agent asks for.
cli.verify.puertos.ninguno: Ports open towards the local network: none.
cli.verify.puertos.abiertos: Ports open towards the local network: {puertos}.
cli.verify.puertos.no_leidos: Ports: could not read the system's list of ports.
cli.verify.puertos.aviso: WARNING: Home Mode is off and there are Guardiana ports open towards the network. Wait a minute and check again; if it stays like this, tell us.
cli.verify.cadena.mal: Ledger: the chain is BROKEN. See guardiana ledger --check.
cli.verify.extracto.sin_permiso: Guardiana may have changed the DNS, but this user cannot check it: only the administrator can read the extract. Run it again with sudo (on Windows, “Run as administrator”).
cli.cli.extracto.sin_permiso: I cannot open this machine's extract: it belongs to the administrator. Run the command again with sudo (on Windows, “Run as administrator”).
cli.verify.cadena.sin_permiso: Extract: it is there, but this user cannot read it. With sudo you get the event count and the chain check.
cli.observe.reconfigurando: Change in the home network or in Home Mode: Guardiana reopens its ports without stopping.
cli.dns.estado.guardiana_primero: This machine's queries go to Guardiana (127.0.0.1).
cli.dns.aplicado_panel: Done. This PC now goes through Guardiana (127.0.0.1). It used to resolve with: {originales}. It can be undone in "Status".
cli.dns.consentimiento_si: To accept, repeat the command with --yes.
cli.dns.reserva_secundario: The resolver you have now stays as the secondary: if Guardiana stops, the machine keeps resolving through it.
cli.dns.solo_guardiana: On this machine Guardiana becomes the only resolver. That is what stops any query slipping past it: systemd-resolved picks among the servers it has, it does not ask them in order, so leaving the old one as a second would mean part of the queries are never seen. The service comes back by itself if it stops, and guardiana dns --restore puts everything back exactly as it was.
cli.verify.dns.guardiana_con_reserva: System DNS: Guardiana (127.0.0.1), with {dns} as the fallback. If Guardiana stops, the machine asks the fallback and those queries are not written down.
cli.verify.dns.por_guardiana: System DNS: Guardiana (127.0.0.1), which forwards to {dns}.
cli.boveda_uso:
Usage:
  guardiana boveda crear [--ruta FOLDER]            creates the vault and shows the 24 words once
  guardiana boveda guardar FILE [--ruta FOLDER]     stores a file, encrypted
  guardiana boveda lista [--ruta FOLDER]            what is inside
  guardiana boveda sacar ID_OR_NAME [--a FILE]      writes a decrypted copy
  guardiana boveda registro [--ruta FOLDER]         every opening, with its chain
  guardiana boveda contrasena [--ruta FOLDER]       changes the password
  guardiana boveda recuperar [--ruta FOLDER]        lost the password: enter with the 24 words and set another
  guardiana boveda trozos [--ruta FOLDER]           splits the 24 words into 5 pieces (3 are enough)
  guardiana boveda juntar                           joins 3 pieces and returns the 24 words
  guardiana boveda capsula DEST_FOLDER              copies the encrypted vault to an external disk, with the reader
  guardiana boveda panel [--ruta FOLDER] [--no-open] opens the vault page in the browser (only on this machine)
Without --ruta, the vault lives in {ruta}.
cli.boveda_clave_distinta: The two passwords do not match. Nothing was changed.
cli.boveda_clave_corta: The password needs at least 10 characters. Nothing was created.
cli.boveda_palabras_titulo: Your 24 recovery words. Shown once only: copy them on paper and keep them away from the computer. Without the password and without these words nobody can open the vault, not even us.
cli.boveda_palabras_confirma: Type «si» once you have them saved
cli.boveda_palabras_pide: Type the 24 words, separated by spaces
cli.boveda_existe_destino: {ruta} already exists; it is not overwritten. Give another destination with --a.
cli.boveda_registro_rota: The log chain breaks at line {n}: someone deleted or changed a line.
cli.boveda_contrasena_cambiada: Password changed. The 24 words stay the same.
cli.boveda_recuperada: Vault opened with the 24 words. Now choose a new password.
cli.boveda_trozos_titulo: Five pieces; any three recover the 24 words. Keep each one in a different place. One piece, or two, reveal nothing.
cli.boveda_juntado: The 24 words, recovered from the pieces:
cli.boveda_capsula: Capsule written at {ruta}: the whole vault, encrypted, with its log.
cli.boveda_capsula_lector: The independent reader goes with it ({lector}): it opens the capsule without GUARDIANA.
cli.boveda_capsula_sin_lector: The independent reader was not found next to the program; the format is published in docs/BOVEDA.md.
cli.boveda_err_clave: Wrong password or words. It is written in the vault's log.
cli.boveda_err_alterado: This object is altered or truncated ({que}); it is not decrypted halfway.
cli.boveda_err_existe: There is already a vault at {ruta}.
cli.boveda_err_no_hay: No vault at {ruta}. Create it with «guardiana boveda crear».
cli.boveda_err_cadena: The log chain breaks at line {n}.
cli.menu.boveda_archivo: Path of the file you want to store in the vault:
cli.menu.boveda_cual: ID or name of the file you want out:
cli.boveda_panel_abriendo: The vault page is at {url} (only on this machine). It closes with «Exit», with Enter here, or by itself after half an hour idle.
cli.boveda_panel_volver: Press Enter here to close the page and go back.
cli.observe.caducado: The trial is over and there is no active subscription. GUARDIANA has put this machine’s DNS back exactly as it was and has stopped watching: your internet keeps working the same. Your extract is whole on your disk and you can take it with you. To watch again, activate Plus in the panel.

oficios.Didomi: The cookie window: collects and stores your consent answer for the site you are visiting.
oficios.Verve Group: Video and mobile advertising: auctions the ad slot you are about to see.
oficios.RTB House: Retargeting: shows you again what you looked at on another site.
oficios.FreeWheel: Television and video advertising, a Comcast company. "user-sync" is matching your identifier between companies.
oficios.OneTag: Ad auction: connects whoever sells the slot with whoever buys it.
oficios.Marfeel: Analytics and advertising for news sites: measures how you read and monetises the page.
oficios.secure.avastdns.com: The antivirus’s own DNS: it resolves names by itself, and while it does GUARDIANA cannot see this machine’s.
oficios.AppsFlyer: Ad attribution: ties this device to the campaign that brought it.
oficios.Adjust: Ad attribution: which ad each install came from.
oficios.Branch: Links and attribution: ties a click to the install it caused.
oficios.Mixpanel: Product analytics: receives events like screen viewed, click or purchase.
oficios.Amplitude: Product analytics: measures what people do inside the app.
oficios.PostHog: Product analytics; in some setups it also records the session.
oficios.Segment: Data pipeline: routes one app's events to other companies.
oficios.Customer.io: Automated emails and messages based on what you do in the app.
oficios.Braze: Messages and notifications based on each user's behaviour.
oficios.Intercom: Support chat: usually ties this device to a customer record.
oficios.Sentry: Error reports: they carry device model, version and some context.
oficios.Datadog: Technical monitoring: logs and performance of the app itself.
oficios.HUMAN Security: Anti-bot check: decides whether you are a person before letting you through.
oficios.Temu: Shop. Its own tracking names measure what you do inside.
oficios.Criteo: Advertising that follows you with what you looked at before.
oficios.Outbrain: Recommended advertising at the end of articles.
oficios.Taboola: Recommended advertising at the end of articles.
oficios.LiveRamp: Identity: turns a signed-in person into an identifier of its own (RampID) used to recognise you across different sites.
oficios.app-measurement.com: Firebase (Google) measurement: the heartbeat every few minutes keeps going with the app closed.
oficios.google-analytics.com: Google's web measurement: counts visits and journeys.
oficios.googletagmanager.com: Tag loader: decides which measurement scripts enter the page.
oficios.doubleclick.net: Google advertising: auction and delivery of ads.
oficios.graph.facebook.com: Meta's interface used by apps: it also measures installs and events.
oficios.Contentsquare: Records how you move around a site: clicks and scrolling (it is the company behind Hotjar).

panel.pie: Guardiana runs entirely on this machine. There is no account, no server of ours, and it sends nothing you do not trigger yourself.
panel.sin_sesion_texto: Open the panel from the Guardiana launcher (or from the guardiana observe window), which includes the session key. The key lives only in memory and is not stored as a cookie.
panel.radiografia_lead: Which services this machine is trying to talk to right now, with their category and one sentence per signal. Real figures from the ledger, no rounding.
panel.radiografia_limite: Guardiana sees service names, not which program asked for them nor what content was sent. It never says "malicious": it says what it observed.
panel.trampa_frase: This name only exists inside one of your trap files. Guardiana did not open that file or any other: all it saw is that something asked for this name, and that name cannot be known without having read the file.
panel.ia_programa_titulo: The program that made those queries, according to Windows itself. Only on this computer: from a phone in Home Mode you see the service name and nothing else.
panel.sin_consultas_aun: No queries yet. Browse a little and they will show up here.
panel.extracto_lead: Every query on record, with who decided what. Filter, export and verify the chain.
panel.cadena_lead: Every entry carries the fingerprint of the previous one. If someone deleted or changed a line, it shows here.
panel.cadena_ok_recortada: Chain verified: {n} events correct; {p} earlier ones already summarised by retention.
panel.cadena_rota: The chain is broken at event {id}: {motivo}.
panel.dispositivos_lead: Totals per device. A device's detail is visible only from that device, unless its owner shares it.
panel.dispositivos_limite: Until Home Mode is on, only this PC appears here. In Home Mode, Guardiana sees service names, not which app asked for them.
panel.sabe_lead: Everything this program stores, where it stores it, and everything it has sent out of this machine.
panel.s_no_respuestas: Only queries are recorded: name, type, device, time, category and verdict. Never the answers, never the content.
panel.retencion_ilimitada: no limit: nothing is deleted, not even when you stop paying
panel.outbound_lead: Every connection the program made by itself: activating the licence, the subscription check once per period, checking the version or updating lists. With whom, when and how many bytes.
panel.outbound_vacio: Guardiana has sent nothing out of this machine.
panel.borrar_lead: Deletes the ledger, the devices, the rules and this record. It cannot be undone.
panel.borrar_confirmar: This deletes everything and cannot be undone. Type DELETE to confirm:
panel.clave_dev: development key, not the release key
panel.estado_limite: Home Mode is not part of version 1.0 on a Mac: GUARDIANA does not manage the macOS firewall and it has not been tested there the way it was on Windows and Linux. Changing the system DNS and the service that starts by itself do work on all three.
panel.hogar_lead: Turns this PC into the DNS guardian of the home Wi‑Fi: phones, TV and everything that uses the Wi‑Fi, without installing anything on them.
panel.hogar_estado_on: Home Mode on since {fecha}. Guardiana listens on the IP {ip} of your local network.
panel.hogar_estado_off: Home Mode off. Guardiana listens only on this PC; no port open towards the network.
panel.hogar_que_pasa: When turned on, Guardiana opens ports only on your local network, never towards the internet: the DNS (53), this panel (7443) and the checker page (80). It is recorded in the ledger. Turning it off closes them. The change takes under a minute; if the Wi‑Fi connects later or changes address, Guardiana notices by itself.
panel.hogar_ip_dinamica: Notice: the IP {ip} of this PC is assigned by the router and may change. If it changes, the phones would lose their DNS. Reserve this IP for this PC in the router ("DHCP reservation", usually under Local network › DHCP) or set a fixed IP.
panel.hogar_ip_fija: The IP {ip} of this PC looks fixed. Good.
panel.hogar_ip_desconocida: Could not tell whether the IP {ip} is fixed or assigned by the router. If it changes, the phones would lose their DNS: better reserve it in the router.
panel.hogar_qr_lead: Scan this code with the phone: it opens the step-by-step guide in this panel and a checker.
panel.hogar_url: Or type in the phone's browser:
panel.hogar_router_texto: In the router, under the DHCP settings, set the IP {ip} as the DNS server. Every device on the Wi‑Fi is covered without touching them. If the provider's router does not allow it, use the per-phone guide.
panel.hogar_iphone_pasos: Settings › Wi‑Fi › tap the (i) of your network › Configure DNS › Manual › Add Server › type {ip} › Save. Remove the other servers from the list.
panel.hogar_android_pasos: Settings › Wi‑Fi › long-press your network › Modify › Advanced options › IP settings: Static › DNS 1: {ip}. Many Android phones also require a fixed IP for the phone: pick a free one on your network (for example the one it already has) and leave the rest as it is.
panel.hogar_comprobar_texto: On the phone, open http://comprobar.guardiana.hogar . If the page "This device already goes through Guardiana" loads, it is done. Only Guardiana resolves that name.
panel.hogar_prueba: Home Mode has no limit of its own: it goes with the licence, like everything else. What matters is that this PC is on.
panel.hogar_limite: Only on the home Wi‑Fi. On mobile data or away from home, the phone does not go through Guardiana. Guardiana sees service names, not which app asked for them. Coverage away from home: coming later. If this PC shuts down or sleeps, phones pointing only at it are left without DNS until it comes back.
panel.hogar_no_admin: Opening the ports and the firewall rule requires running Guardiana as administrator.

panel.reglas_titulo: Rules: what is cut and what is allowed
panel.reglas_lead: No rule exists unless you create it. Every cut records who decided it and when. Undoing never deletes: it records that it was undone.
panel.reglas_inviolables: Never cut, not even with a rule per category: system updates, time, resolvers, recognised messaging and video calls. A device with fewer than 24 hours observed receives no cut.
panel.reglas_nueva_lead: Cut or allow an exact name, a family of names (the domain and everything under it) or a whole category, for one device or for the whole home.
panel.reglas_ninguna: There are no rules. Guardiana only watches.
panel.leyenda_desconocido: "Local network" is the devices in your home finding each other: it never leaves. "Delivery" is a network that carries other companies' content: not the destination, the road. "Apple's", "Google's"… says who the name belongs to: a label, never a verdict. "Unclassified" means no open tracking list knows it; not that it is suspicious.
panel.alcance_cortar_todo: It applies to the whole device, not only to the agent: GUARDIANA sees names, not programs.
panel.alcance_cortar_aviso:

panel.alcance_cortar_on: On. While the AI works, it only reaches what is on the list. Everything else is cut and shows up here for you to decide.
panel.alcance_cortado_aviso: Cutting here stops the next attempt. It does not undo what was already sent, and it does not reach an agent that does not go through this resolver.

panel.licencia_lead: One program: 7 days free with everything, and after that it needs a subscription. While it is active GUARDIANA watches and keeps everything; when it is not, it stops watching and puts this machine’s DNS back as it was. What was written down stays on your disk.
panel.licencia_prueba: Trial: {d} days left (ends on {fecha}). Nothing is charged; when it ends GUARDIANA stops watching until you activate a subscription.
panel.licencia_prueba_texto: This counter lives on your machine. Reinstalling resets it. We trust you.
panel.licencia_prueba_agotada: The trial ended on {fecha}. GUARDIANA has stopped watching and has put this machine’s DNS back as it was: your internet works the same. What was written down is whole on your disk and you can export it. To watch again, activate your licence key.
panel.licencia_clave_lead: The key arrives by email when you pay. One connection to {host}, started by you, to activate it; then one check per billing period (monthly or yearly), recorded in "What Guardiana knows about you". Nothing else leaves your machine.
panel.licencia_dev: This program carries the development key: it is a working build, not the released version.
panel.licencia_limite: Without a subscription GUARDIANA stops watching and puts this machine’s DNS back as it was: your internet does not break. Cancelling deletes nothing of what was written down.

panel.hogar_suspension: Notice: this PC goes to sleep by itself (plugged in: {ac}; on battery: {dc}). While it sleeps, phones pointing only at it are left without DNS. Set it to "Never" in Settings › System › Power & battery › Screen and sleep, or add the router as secondary DNS on the phones.

panel.hueco: Guardiana was not watching between {desde} and {hasta}. It is on record.

panel.licencia_comprobacion_pendiente: Subscription {periodo}. The key is due for a check; Guardiana will do it on its next pass. If it cannot before {limite}, it will stop watching and put the DNS back as it was.
panel.licencia_comprobacion_fallida: Subscription {periodo}. The key could not be checked (no connection to the gateway). Guardiana retries hourly; if it does not manage before {limite}, it will stop watching and put the DNS back as it was.

panel.licencia_de_por_vida: Lifetime licence: paid once, it does not expire. Guardiana checks the key when it can, but Plus is never switched off for a check it could not make — not offline, not with the machine off for months. The only thing that ends it is the gateway saying the key is no longer valid, after a refund for instance, and that is said here with its date.

panel.ia_lead: An artificial-intelligence agent on your machine works with your keys: your folders, your accounts, your network. Here you see which services it talks to, from which device and when.
panel.ia_limite: Guardiana checks where it talks, not the content. It sees service names; it does not see the files a program opens nor what travels inside each connection. What leaves through an app’s own encrypted DNS or a VPN does not pass through here either, and is recorded when detected.

panel.ia_servicios_lead: From our open list of artificial-intelligence services. One showing up does not mean it is doing anything wrong: it means that device looked it up.
panel.ia_sin_servicios: No AI service seen on this machine yet.
panel.alcance_lead: You gave an agent permission for a task. Write here which services it needs for that. With Guard mode off, Guardiana only shows you what went beyond; with it on, it cuts and brings each name here for you to decide.
panel.alcance_nuevo_lead: One service per line. The domain and everything under it counts: writing github.com includes api.github.com. Once saved it appears above, with the Guard mode switch so it also cuts what falls outside.
panel.alcance_borrado: Scope removed: this device has nothing declared again.
panel.alcance_fuera: {n} names beyond what was declared in 24 hours
panel.alcance_fuera_ninguno: Nothing beyond what was declared in the last 24 hours.
panel.alcance_esperado_nota: System updates, time, resolvers and recognised messaging never count as "beyond": they are the machine keeping itself alive, not the agent.
panel.alcance_limite: This checks destinations, not intentions: it says which services a device tried to reach, not what it did with them nor which files it opened. An agent working only with files on your disk does not show up here, because it asks for no name.
panel.bov_lead: Your documents, encrypted on this machine with your master password. Nothing leaves here: not to us, not to anyone.
panel.bov_crear_lead: Choose a master password of at least 10 characters. Without it and without the 24 words you will see next, nobody can open the vault, not even us.
panel.bov_palabras_texto: Shown once only. Copy them on paper and keep them away from the computer: they open the vault if you lose the password.
panel.bov_recuperar_lead: Type the 24 words and choose a new password. The words keep working afterwards.
panel.bov_bloqueo: It locks itself after 10 idle minutes.
panel.bov_guardar_lead: It is encrypted here, on this machine, with its own key. The original is not touched.
panel.bov_registro_ok: The log chain is intact: {n} lines.
panel.bov_registro_rota: The chain breaks at line {n}: someone deleted or changed a line.
panel.bov_clave_corta: The password needs at least 10 characters.
panel.bov_clave_distinta: The two passwords do not match.
panel.bov_cerrada: The vault is locked. Open it with the password.
panel.bov_salido: The vault is locked and this page no longer answers. You can close the tab or go back to the panel.
panel.bov_limite: Limits, said here: the password travels from this page to the program inside your machine (127.0.0.1), never outside. Keys are wiped from memory when the vault is locked. There is no back door: lose the password and the 24 words and the content is lost. The format is public and a separate reader opens the vault without GUARDIANA.
panel.bov_espera: One moment: the password is turned into a key slowly, on purpose.
panel.hogar_mac: Home Mode is not part of version 1.0 on a Mac. It works, but GUARDIANA does not manage the macOS firewall and we have not tested it here the way we did on Windows and Linux, so we do not vouch for it yet. The site says the same.
